patthana8.61:1.1: na savitakkaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na savitakko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: tīṇi.
patthana8.61:2.1: na avitakkaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na avitakko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: tīṇi.
patthana8.61:3.1: na savitakkañca na avitakkañca dhammaṃ paṭicca na savitakko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: tīṇi.
